note: P00 records engine identity and the observed command surface. Capability qualification, integration routes, permissions, and cost implications are populated in P01 against this pinned binary.

engine.name: Codewhale
engine.install: npm global under /opt/homebrew (wrapper) + native binary bin/downloads/codewhale
engine.source_reference: https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale (tag/commit to be pinned at P01)

observed_cli_commands.name: run
observed_cli_commands.description: Run an interactive or non-interactive task

observed_cli_commands.name: doctor
observed_cli_commands.description: Run Codewhale diagnostics

observed_cli_commands.name: session-diagnostics
observed_cli_commands.description: Summarize local session failure signals without raw content

observed_cli_commands.name: scorecard
observed_cli_commands.description: Score recorded turn metrics against an optional baseline

observed_cli_commands.name: models
observed_cli_commands.description: List cached models; use --update to refresh configured provider catalogs

observed_cli_commands.name: speech
observed_cli_commands.description: Generate speech audio with Xiaomi MiMo TTS models [alias: tts]

observed_cli_commands.name: sessions
observed_cli_commands.description: List saved sessions

observed_cli_commands.name: receipts
observed_cli_commands.description: Show what a session did: files, commands, web and MCP calls, agents, approvals, and failures. `codewhale receipts [ID|--last] [--format md|json]` [alias: receipt]

observed_cli_commands.name: resume
observed_cli_commands.description: Resume a saved session

observed_cli_commands.name: rc
observed_cli_commands.description: Launch an interactive session and hand it to the Codewhale web app

observed_cli_commands.name: fork
observed_cli_commands.description: Fork a saved session

observed_cli_commands.name: init
observed_cli_commands.description: Create a default AGENTS.md in the current directory

observed_cli_commands.name: install
observed_cli_commands.description: Install a plugin bundle without trusting or enabling it

observed_cli_commands.name: setup
observed_cli_commands.description: Bootstrap MCP config and/or skills directories

observed_cli_commands.name: remote-setup
observed_cli_commands.description: Generate a remote Codewhale agent deploy bundle (cloud + chat bridge)

observed_cli_commands.name: exec
observed_cli_commands.description: Run a non-interactive prompt

observed_cli_commands.name: fleet
observed_cli_commands.description: Manage durable Agent fleet runs

observed_cli_commands.name: workflow
observed_cli_commands.description: Run checked-in Workflows through a Lane Runtime backend

observed_cli_commands.name: lane
observed_cli_commands.description: Manage running workflow instances (Lanes) and Runtime backends (#4176)

observed_cli_commands.name: review
observed_cli_commands.description: Run a Codewhale-powered code review over a git diff

observed_cli_commands.name: apply
observed_cli_commands.description: Apply a patch file or stdin to the working tree

observed_cli_commands.name: eval
observed_cli_commands.description: Run the offline evaluation harness

observed_cli_commands.name: mcp
observed_cli_commands.description: Manage MCP servers

observed_cli_commands.name: features
observed_cli_commands.description: Inspect feature flags

observed_cli_commands.name: integrations
observed_cli_commands.description: Connect third-party harnesses through Codewhale (e.g. `integrations dsh status`)

observed_cli_commands.name: serve
observed_cli_commands.description: Run a local Codewhale server

observed_cli_commands.name: web
observed_cli_commands.description: Open the first-class local browser client over the canonical Runtime API

observed_cli_commands.name: login
observed_cli_commands.description: Sign in to an existing Codewhale account; new accounts are not open

observed_cli_commands.name: logout
observed_cli_commands.description: Remove saved authentication state (every provider key, OAuth login, the Codewhale account session). Asks before deleting

observed_cli_commands.name: auth
observed_cli_commands.description: Manage authentication credentials and provider mode

observed_cli_commands.name: account
observed_cli_commands.description: Manage an existing Codewhale account; new accounts are not open [alias: cloud]

observed_cli_commands.name: dispatch
observed_cli_commands.description: Run a task on a Codewhale cloud computer (not available: cloud computers and accounts are paused for new users)

observed_cli_commands.name: mcp-server
observed_cli_commands.description: Run MCP server mode over stdio

observed_cli_commands.name: config
observed_cli_commands.description: Read/write/list config values

observed_cli_commands.name: model
observed_cli_commands.description: Resolve or list available models across providers

observed_cli_commands.name: thread
observed_cli_commands.description: Manage thread/session metadata and resume/fork flows

observed_cli_commands.name: sandbox
observed_cli_commands.description: Evaluate sandbox/approval policy decisions

observed_cli_commands.name: app-server
observed_cli_commands.description: Expose the full Engine API with --http, or smaller compatibility controls

observed_cli_commands.name: completion
observed_cli_commands.description: Generate shell completions [alias: completions]

observed_cli_commands.name: metrics
observed_cli_commands.description: Print a usage rollup from the audit log and session store

observed_cli_commands.name: update
observed_cli_commands.description: Update this release binary from GitHub (package-managed installs get migration instructions)

observed_cli_commands.name: providers
observed_cli_commands.description: Export the route catalog (`providers export --json`)

observed_cli_commands.name: help
observed_cli_commands.description: Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)
